definitions.gloss: to oppose, to object, to be against
definitions.explanation: To express disagreement with or resistance to a proposal, plan, or idea.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{戦争|せんそう}に{反対|はんたい}している。
{親|おや}が{結婚|けっこん}に{反対|はんたい}した。
{反対|はんたい}の{方|かた}はいらっしゃいますか。

notes:
{反対|はんたい}する means to oppose or object to something.

PATTERN:
〜に{反対|はんたい}する: to oppose/object to ~

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {反対|はんたい}{意見|いけん}: opposing opinion
- {反対票|はんたいひょう}: vote against
- {反対運動|はんたいうんどう}: opposition movement
- {反対派|はんたいは}: opposition faction
- {反対|はんたい}{側|がわ}: opposite side; opposition

NOUN USE:
{反対|はんたい} alone can mean "opposite" or "opposition":
- {反対|はんたい}の{方向|ほうこう}: opposite direction
- {賛成|さんせい}か{反対|はんたい}か: for or against

CONTRAST:
- {反対|はんたい}する: to oppose (disagree with)
- {賛成|さんせい}する: to agree with, support
